setup.title: Thanks for adding me to {guild} 🎶
setup.intro: I'm DJ DIKKAT, a free music bot. No ads, no premium, no paywall.
setup.steps:
- To start, join a voice channel and type `/play`
- To run everything from your browser, type `/panel`
- To change my language, type `/language`
- To see what this server listens to, type `/stats`
setup.panel.head: 🎛️ Web panel
setup.panel.body:
Player, playlists, roles & permissions, welcome messages and stats, all in your browser:
- [{host}/dashboard]({url})
setup.free.head: 💸 Free forever
setup.free.body: No hidden costs, no trials. Like it? [Support it on Patreon]({patreon})
setup.start.reply:
**Getting started in 3 steps**
1. Join a voice channel.
2. Type `/play` and a song name or link. Pick a suggestion while you type.
3. Use the buttons on the player card to pause, skip, loop or shuffle.

Server admins: type `/panel` to open the web panel (roles, welcome messages, stats).

launch.title: DJ DIKKAT just got a big upgrade
launch.intro: New look, a smarter bot under the hood, and a web panel where you set things up the way your server likes.
launch.list:
- **Web panel:** player, playlists and history right in your browser
- **Roles & permissions:** DJ roles, music channels and rules for every command
- **Welcome cards:** greet new members with a picture card
- **Moderation basics:** link and word filters, roles on join, leave messages
- **Stats:** your server's top songs, top listeners and busiest hours
